input.content:
import zipfile, sys, os

base = sys.argv[1]
docx = os.path.join(base, "report.docx")
pdf = os.path.join(base, "report.pdf")

z = zipfile.ZipFile(docx)
xml = z.read("word/document.xml").decode("utf-8")
print("gridSpan:", xml.count("w:gridSpan"))
print("vMerge:", xml.count("w:vMerge"))
print("drawings:", xml.count("<w:drawing>"))
print("images:", [n for n in z.namelist() if n.startswith("word/media")])
print("hyperlinks:", xml.count("<w:hyperlink"))
print("vertAlign(sub/sup):", xml.count("w:vertAlign"))

try:
    from pypdf import PdfReader
except ImportError:
    from PyPDF2 import PdfReader

r = PdfReader(pdf)
print("pdf pages:", len(r.pages))
text = "".join((p.extract_text() or "") for p in r.pages)
for key in ["2026 年第三季度经营报告", "4,820", "分区域", "SELECT region", "finance@example.com"]:
    print("pdf contains", key, "->", key in text)
